lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1 (upper web 2 to step 6), about 90 deg with an Ri ~ t arc. In the 25/50/75% sections the line sits on the outer arc apex (dy 0.04/0.02/0.02 mm). In the close-ups the line runs the whole step face, about 1-2 mm short at each end.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2 (step 7 to lower web 3), about 90 deg. In the sections the line is on the outer apex (dy 0.01/0.02/0.04 mm) and it covers the fold between the two side flanges.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Front flange 5 (bent up 9 mm) along the full upper web. It is one line across the notch and holes, as the rule says. The station_median apex holds up: dy +0.19/-0.20/-0.10 mm on the slightly bowed 211 mm fold. The line runs from about -145 to +68, and the flange from about -147 to +70.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Web 2 to back flange 8, about 90 deg. In the sections the line is on the outer apex (dy 0.03/-0.16/-0.36 mm, worst at 75%, still under 1 mm). It covers the whole flange from the step corner to the end of the flange.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Vertical fold between step 6 and the 30 mm end tab of the L-shaped flange 8. Its own close-up and sections show a real Ri ~ t arc on the outer apex (dy 0.01/-0.01/0.04). The 27 mm line covers about 27-30 mm of fold.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Web 2 to the small back tab 20 at the left end, bent down about 10 mm. Outer apex dy -0.04/0.03/0.11 mm. It is collinear with B4 (within 0.45 mm) but is its own plate: the web edge is cut back for 89 mm and no flange material links them. So it is not a fold interrupted by a window, and a separate line is correct.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Web 2 to the left end flange 10 (20 mm, about 90 deg). The extent override covers the full flange width (-25 to 18), and the stored 0.44 coverage is only the auto-fit number. Sections dy 0.02 mm at all three stations.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Step 6 to its front side flange 19. The fold is clean in all close-ups and the sections sit on the outer apex (dy 0.04/0.02/0.01 mm). It covers the full length of the step.

lines.label: B9

lines.label: B10
lines.reason: Lower web 4 to back flange 17, bent down 9 mm. Sections dy 0.01/0.01/0.02 mm (hole collars near the flange show up as noise in the 50/75% slices) and the line covers the full length.
